warnings:
Generate a fresh suite only when no existing tests exist; otherwise generate only missing scenarios. Fresh/full generation must include at least 25 test cases (expand to 50–60 when complex; cap at 60). Never emit duplicates. Each case has only title, steps, expected_results with equal step and expected-result counts.

Rule 1: Never generate duplicate test cases.
Rule 2: If no existing test cases exist, generate a fresh test suite.
Rule 3: If existing test cases exist, generate only missing scenarios.
Rule 4: Always analyze the User Story before selecting test categories.
Rule 5: Core categories: Positive, Negative, Edge Cases, Validation, Regression.
Rule 6: Optional categories are included only when applicable.
Rule 7: Every test step must have exactly one corresponding expected result.
Rule 8: Each test case contains only: Test Title, Test Steps, Expected Results.
Rule 9: Reject invalid output where the number of steps and expected results differ.
Rule 10: Never infer requirements that are not present. Report requirement gaps instead.
Rule 11: Fresh/full generation: produce at least 25 test cases for typical stories. Expand to 50–60 only when the story is complex (high/critical risk, multiple AC items, many Scenario N blocks, or long AC text). Short/simple stories must stay near 25 — do not pad to 50 with generic cases.
